summary: ms-client-portal exfiltrates installer host identifiers to hardcoded IP on install
details: The package's preinstall and postinstall lifecycle scripts in package.json run an inline `node -e` command that issues plain-HTTP GET requests to the bare IP 38.242.235.206 at the path /depconf/ms-client-portal/{pre,post}install, carrying the installer's USER/USERNAME environment variable, OS hostname (os.hostname()), and current working directory (process.cwd()) as query parameters. The requests fire automatically on `npm install` with no opt-in, no configurability, and no TLS. The destination is a bare-IP endpoint unrelated to any declared publisher, and the path structure (`/depconf/<package-name>/`) is the canonical shape of a dependency-confusion reconnaissance beacon used to identify internal environments that resolve a public package name instead of a private one.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
